name: styles
title: Squishy styles
description: Tailwind v4 stylesheet with the type scale, shape tokens, light/dark surfaces, brand themes and every component class. Needs the m6x11plus font in public/fonts.
docs: Add `@import "./styles/global.css"` to your layout and put m6x11plus.ttf in public/fonts (https://managore.itch.io/m6x11). Enable the Tailwind Vite plugin in astro.config.mjs.
